items.title: core/story-recall.ts: build story profiles + structured similarity scoring (no FTS)
items.context: experience-layer-types.ts: StoryProfile {storyId,title,type,phase,priority,keywords[],fileKinds[],touchpoints[],riskSignals[],notableFindings[],notableDecisions[],outcome}. core/story-recall.ts: buildStoryProfile(storyMeta) + scoreSimilarity(a,b) using structured-field overlap (Jaccard over keyword/fileKind/touchpoint sets + type/phase match). Pure, deterministic; zero outward imports except experience-layer-types + node:.
items.userSees: Build clean; the smoke asserts scoreSimilarity ranks an overlapping profile above a disjoint one and is symmetric/deterministic.

happy.desc: buildStoryProfile(storyMeta) returns a StoryProfile with all expected fields populated (storyId, title, type, phase, priority, keywords[], fileKinds[], touchpoints[], riskSignals[], notableFindings[], notableDecisions[], outcome); WHY: proves the profile builder extracts structured data from story metadata
scoreSimilarity(profileA, profileB) where A and B share keywords+fileKinds+type returns a score > 0; WHY: proves overlapping profiles produce a positive similarity score

scoreSimilarity(overlapping, disjoint) > scoreSimilarity(overlapping, totallyDifferent); overlapping profile outranks disjoint; WHY: core ranking invariant — stories with shared structure must score higher

edge.desc: scoreSimilarity(a, b) === scoreSimilarity(b, a) for any two profiles; WHY: similarity must be symmetric — asymmetry would cause inconsistent ranking
scoreSimilarity called twice with identical inputs returns identical score; WHY: determinism — non-deterministic scoring would make ranking unstable

scoreSimilarity where profiles share only one field dimension (same type, zero keyword/fileKind overlap) returns low but non-zero score; WHY: multi-field ensures no single-keyword coincidence dominates
buildStoryProfile with empty/minimal storyMeta (no files, no findings, no decisions) returns valid StoryProfile with empty arrays, no crash; WHY: graceful degradation for stories with sparse metadata
scoreSimilarity(emptyProfile, emptyProfile) returns 0 not NaN/Infinity; WHY: Jaccard(empty,empty) edge case must not produce NaN

adversarial.desc: scoreSimilarity with profiles containing duplicate keywords ([auth,auth,auth]) produces same score as deduplicated version; WHY: duplicate injection should not inflate similarity
buildStoryProfile with storyMeta containing unexpected/extra fields does not crash and ignores them; WHY: forward-compatibility — future metadata fields must not break profile building

story-recall.ts import fence: module imports only experience-layer-types + node: builtins (non-vacuous mutation check); WHY: coupling guard — recall importing handler/gate modules violates isolation contract

items.title: recallSimilarStories over the existing story_list scan (reuse, no derived index)
items.context: core/story-recall.ts: recallSimilarStories(targetProfile, candidateProfiles, topN) returns ranked matches with match reasons. The handler feeds it profiles built from the StoryStore enumeration (the existing story_list scan) — NO FTS, NO new derived index. The recall path is read-only.
items.userSees: The smoke seeds several stories, builds profiles via the store enumeration, and asserts recall returns the most-similar story first, respects top-N, and writes nothing.

happy.desc: recallSimilarStories(targetProfile, [similarCandidate, disjointCandidate], topN=5) returns similarCandidate ranked first; WHY: proves the recall function correctly ranks by similarity score
recallSimilarStories returns match reasons for each result explaining why it ranked; WHY: match reasons are a required output field for user-facing recall

edge.desc: recallSimilarStories with empty candidates array returns empty result, no crash; WHY: empty candidate set must not throw
recallSimilarStories with topN=1 returns exactly one result even when multiple candidates score > 0; WHY: top-N truncation must drop lowest-ranked
recallSimilarStories excludes the target story itself from results (self-exclusion); WHY: a story should not recall itself as its own most-similar match
recallSimilarStories with topN=0 returns empty array; WHY: boundary — requesting zero results should work without crash
recallSimilarStories where all candidates score 0 (completely disjoint) returns empty array; WHY: zero-score candidates should be filtered out, not returned with score 0

adversarial.desc: recallSimilarStories with a large candidate set (100+ profiles) returns results within reasonable time and correct ranking; WHY: performance guard — real stores may have hundreds of stories
recallSimilarStories is read-only: calling it does not create any files or modify the store; WHY: recall must be side-effect-free, no derived-index file created
recallSimilarStories with candidates containing malformed/partial profiles (missing keywords, missing fileKinds) does not crash; WHY: real store data may have legacy/sparse stories

items.title: handlers/recall.ts CLI (recall --story / --query --top) + registration; read-only
items.context: handlers/recall.ts: `recall --story <id>` profiles that story and prints top-N similar prior stories with match reasons + notable findings/decisions/outcome; `recall --query "..."` builds an ad-hoc keyword profile. Reuses the store enumeration; read-only (no writes, no gate). Register via command-policy(readOnly)/config/registry/cli-engine (flat underscore: recall).
items.userSees: `recall --story <id>` prints a ranked top-N list with match reasons; `recall --query "worker schedule"` returns keyword-matched stories; no files are written.

happy.desc: recall --story <id> prints top-N ranked similar stories with match reasons + notable findings/decisions/outcome; WHY: proves the primary CLI mode works end-to-end
recall --query "worker schedule" returns keyword-matched stories from the store; WHY: proves the ad-hoc keyword query mode works
recall handler is registered in command-policy as readOnly and in config/registry/cli-engine with flat underscore name; WHY: proves registration wiring is complete

edge.desc: recall --story <nonexistent-id> prints an informative error or empty result, no crash; WHY: user may typo a story ID
recall --top 0 returns empty output, no crash; WHY: boundary for top-N parameter
recall with no --story and no --query prints usage/help, no crash; WHY: user omits required argument
recall --query with empty string returns empty result or error, no crash; WHY: degenerate query input

adversarial.desc: recall --story <id> writes NOTHING to disk (no files created/modified in .lattice/ or anywhere); WHY: recall is read-only — any write violates the contract
recall --story <id> does not create a derived-index file anywhere; WHY: explicit contract — no FTS/derived-index
recall --query with special characters/injection (e.g. quotes, semicolons, newlines) does not crash or execute anything; WHY: input sanitization for CLI argument

items.title: Smoke + npm script + no regression
items.context: tasks/experience-layer-recall-smoke.ts + package.json test:experience-layer-recall. Hermetic. Assert: profile building; similarity ranking + top-N; recall reuses story_list scan (no FTS engine / no derived-index file created); read-only (no writes); zero outward coupling (recall module); build clean; existing experience-layer smokes still pass.
items.userSees: npm run test:experience-layer-recall exits 0 'smoke passed'; committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; existing smokes still pass.

happy.desc: npm run test:experience-layer-recall exits 0 and outputs smoke passed; WHY: proves the smoke script is wired and passes
Committed verifier prints TOTAL N | PASS N | FAIL 0; WHY: proves all smoke assertions pass with zero failures
Existing experience-layer smokes still pass (no regression); WHY: new recall code must not break prior experience-layer functionality

edge.desc: Build clean (tsc) after all changes with zero type errors; WHY: new types and imports must not break the build
Smoke is hermetic: runs successfully in a clean temp directory with no pre-existing .lattice/learning state; WHY: smoke must not depend on leftover state from prior runs

adversarial.desc: Recall module (core/story-recall.ts) import fence is non-vacuous: file exists, contains real exports, and imports ONLY experience-layer-types + node: builtins; WHY: the import fence is the load-bearing isolation bar — must be checked as a mutation guard, not just a static fact

No derived-index file exists after smoke run: no file matching *recall-index* or *recall-cache* or *story-recall-derived* appears anywhere in .lattice/; WHY: explicit contract — recall is scan-only, no caching
